what this tells us: BPJS paid JKP cash benefit to 90,513 workers in 2025, total Rp1.01 trillion, plus labour-market information and training access. Total BPJS benefit spend in 2025 was Rp68.24tn across 5.77m claims, so JKP is about 1.5% of it: JKP is small next to JHT and is the only benefit that tracks layoffs directly.
why it matters: The closest thing Indonesia has to a shock meter, and it is rising fast
possible other factors: Policy or rule change: PP 6/2025 (7 Feb 2025) raised JKP cash benefit to 60% of wage for up to 6 months and eased access, so 2025 and 2026 values are not on the same rule as earlier years. Scope: JKP recipients are formal-sector workers who claim; coverage is limited (press puts eligible JKP claimants at roughly 14-15% of about 50 million formal workers). Measurement: BPJS reports cumulative-to-date figures in press releases with different cut-off dates; recipients and rupiah value move for different reasons (a higher share paid per claim lifts value even when recipients fall).
source: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan press release, \"BPJS Ketenagakerjaan Bayarkan Manfaat Rp68,24 Triliun Sepanjang 2025\" (2025 full year)
